title: Materialize admitted promotion as candidate Mission envelope
goal: Convert an admitted DECK-PROMOTE receipt into a durable candidate Mission envelope while preserving proposal and promotion evidence and starting no execution.
laws: Only an ADMITTED MISSION_PROMOTION_REQUEST may materialize a candidate.
The referenced DECK-MISSION proposal must also be ADMITTED.
Candidate envelopes live under missions/candidates and are not canonical V2 missions.
Candidate identity is deterministic and replay-idempotent.
Proposal objective and project context remain content-bound evidence.
No V2 mission ID is allocated by this mission.
No active mission, Talos, Hephaestus, Worker, shell or execution path is started.
